interpretation.phenotypes: Only early_negative targets have synthetic negative N1. Other injected targets are phenotype challenges, not uniformly original-joint-null cases. Contact call rates are descriptive; correlated contacts are not treated as independent binomial observations.
interpretation.pure_null: Family any-call rate across independent all-noise families; Wilson95% intervals use families, not contacts, as binomial units.
interpretation.scope: Fixed stationary AR(1) physical-unit simulation, not universal N1-specific calibration or fresh clinical validation.
